title: Club Founded
text: A handful of international students who missed weekend football back home started kicking a ball around the North Quad. By the end of the semester there were enough of them for two five-a-side teams.

title: First League Entry
text: NJUIT INT FC entered the NJ Collegiate League's second division as an associate club, fielding a squad drawn from twelve different countries in its debut season.

title: Promotion Season
text: An unbeaten spring campaign carried the club into the league's top division for the first time, finishing second only on goal difference.

title: The Bridge Year
text: Matches paused for two terms. The squad kept the club alive with weekly video calls and a five-a-side return the moment campus reopened.

title: Regional Cup Run
text: The club reached its first Regional Cup semifinal, drawing the largest crowd in club history to a home fixture under the North Quad floodlights.

title: Ten Years On
text: A reunion match brought back alumni from nine countries to mark a decade of the club, followed by the first edition of the now-annual Founders' Cup.

title: Current Squad
text: This season's roster represents fourteen nationalities, the widest the club has ever fielded, competing across the NJ Collegiate League and the Regional Cup.
